ask: this is a mess muse fix it
sentence: Collects going, maybe or no answers with short notes for one fixed event, shows progress toward a needed head count, and lets a going person lock the plan once enough say going.
use_when: A group needs to confirm an outing only if enough people can come
Someone wants to see who is going, maybe or not, with a short note each
The plan should be locked once a minimum number commit
A friend group is deciding on a night out with a set time
dont_use_when: The group needs to vote between several different options or dates
The event details such as title or time need to be edited in chat
A split of costs or a task list is needed rather than attendance
